Core\\Cache::shared.perf: The member dials a store the sweep does not run: unconfigured, every iteration measures the refusal, and configured, it measures another server and the network between them rather than Novis.

Core\\Db\\Row::instant.perf: Every bench runs on SQLite, which has no zone-carrying column type, so a loop here would measure the refusal rather than the read.
Core\\Db\\Row::instant.hostile: Every attack runs on SQLite, which has no zone-carrying column type, so the member refuses every column the attack could put in front of it.

Core\\Net::connectLocal.perf: The member needs a Unix-domain transport, which this build has only on Unix, and the perf ledger is measured on Windows; the bench on disk is marked `requires: unix` and passes there.

Core\\Net::listenLocal.perf: The member needs a Unix-domain transport, which this build has only on Unix, and the perf ledger is measured on Windows; the bench on disk is marked `requires: unix` and passes there.

Core\\RateLimit::consume.perf: The member runs its step in a store the sweep does not run: unconfigured, every iteration measures the refusal, and configured, it measures another server and the network between them rather than Novis; `Core\RateLimit::shed` runs the same arithmetic in this process and carries the figure.

Core\\Script::finish.perf: A script ends once at `finish()`, so nothing can be iterated: a bench here would measure startup, and a loop of child scripts that each finish would measure the spawn, not the ending.

Core\\Test::advance.perf: A bench runs under `nvs run`, where no `#[Test(at: ...)]` fixes a clock, so every iteration would measure the `LogicError` rather than the move.

Core\\Test::assertCompletes.perf: A bench runs under `nvs run`, where no `#[Test(at: ...)]` fixes a clock, so every iteration would measure the `LogicError` thrown before the body runs rather than the check.

Novis\\Image\\Diff::constructor.hostile: `new Diff` stores five typed read-only values and calls nothing, so a wrong value does not compile and there is no input left to attack.

Novis\\Spreadsheet\\Cell::constructor.examples: `new Cell` stores two values and calls nothing; `Cell::of` makes the same cell, and its examples show every way a cell is used.

Novis\\Spreadsheet\\Export::constructor.examples: `new Export` stores its function and options and calls nothing; a program meets an `Export` from `Workbook::fromRows` or `Template::fill`, and the examples of `save`, `to`, `bytes` and `download` show it, one of them through `new Export`.
Novis\\Spreadsheet\\Export::constructor.perf: `new Export` stores three values and calls nothing; `Workbook::fromRows` builds one on every call, so the benches of `download`, `save`, `to` and `bytes` include this one.
Novis\\Spreadsheet\\Export::constructor.hostile: `new Export` stores three typed read-only values and calls nothing, so a wrong value does not compile; the function it stores runs only in the four write methods, whose attacks give it a function that throws and one that adds no sheet.

Novis\\Spreadsheet\\Formula::constructor.hostile: `new Formula` stores two typed read-only values and calls nothing, so a wrong value does not compile; formula text and cached values are written when the row is written, and the attack of `Formula::of` sends hostile ones.

Novis\\Spreadsheet\\Style::constructor.examples: `new Style` stores two values and calls nothing; a program makes a style with `Style::of`, whose examples show every way a style is used.

Novis\\Spreadsheet\\Style::constructor.hostile: `new Style` stores two typed read-only values and calls nothing, so a wrong value does not compile; the names and text a user can give a style are checked in `Style::of`, whose attack sends them.

lang:attributes/core-api-and-the-openapi.perf: `#[Api]` is read while the program compiles and has no runtime surface to iterate; a loop here would measure the annotated method call instead.

lang:attributes/the-names-the-compiler-a.perf: A name is recognized while the program compiles and reaches nothing at run time; a loop here would re-measure the codec, route or command row the recognized attribute built, each of which carries its own figure.

lang:classes/what-a-class-cannot-declare.perf: Every declaration here is a compile error, so there is no program to iterate; the replacements carry their own figures.

lang:errors/fatal-errors-limits-no-catch.perf: A `FATAL` stops the program where it stands, so there is nothing to iterate; the allocation accounting that reaches the ceiling is measured by every allocating member's own figure.

lang:expressions/operators-that-do-not-p.perf: Every operator here is a compile error, so there is no program to iterate; the replacements carry their own figures.

lang:expressions/refused-in-expression-p.perf: Every construct here is a compile error, so there is no program to iterate; the replacements carry their own figures.

lang:iteration/what-does-not-exist.perf: Every name here is a compile error, so there is no program to iterate; the replacements carry their own figures.

tools:agents/nvs-agent-init.hostile: `nvs agent init` reads no program, so no program can attack it; what can is an `AGENTS.md` or an adapter it did not write, and those files are pinned by `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs`.

tools:cli/nvs-info.hostile: `nvs info` reads no program and takes one flag, so no program can attack it; the argument spellings that must not reach it are pinned by `crates/nvs-cli/tests/info.rs`.
